name: Saigou Takamori
source:
"If we give in it will be the end of Satsuma."
A warrior of the Satsuma domain, even though he has bad feelings about the Choushuu after the Hamaguri rebellion, with [url=/c43495]Sakamoto Ryouma[/url] as an intermediary he allies himself with them in order to defeat the Shogunate.
A stubborn man with great political ability.
